event_detail: Steak: the gripper closes at the steak on the plate (closed fingers at 59.2-60.8 s) without picking it up, opens and rises at 62.4 s, then comes down on the steak again at 64.0 s; the steak never leaves the plate.
evidence: Knife lies on the cutting board in all frames (stage 1 done). Wrist camera: fingers nearly closed right over the steak at 59.2 and 60.8 s while the steak stays on the plate; at 62.4 s fingers are open and the camera is higher with the steak still on the plate; at 64.0 s the open gripper is descending onto the steak again. Shoulder views show the steak on the plate and the gripper empty throughout. This is a repeated failed grasp, so it could also be labelled no_progress.
